doc: Performance regression thresholds for headless tests (SPEC §4.2). Budgets are the spec limits; test thresholds keep headroom below them so a real regression fails before the budget is reached. Measured on the dummy renderer (CPU only), see docs/kb/tech/architecture.md 'Scene-swap hitch'.

scene_swap.load_note: Above this 1-minute load average per CPU the machine is oversubscribed (e.g. many parallel agents rendering on CPU) and wall-clock budgets are not measurable: the test reports the numbers as a warning instead of failing. Real CI runners stay far below it.
